Transitionist v1.0.0 - Installation Instructions
===========================================

INSTALLATION:
1. Double-click "Transitionist-by-TACHES.pkg"
2. Follow the installation prompts
3. The installer will copy Transitionist to your system folders:
   - VST3: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Transitionist.vst3
   - AU: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Transitionist.component

FIRST USE (IMPORTANT):
macOS will show a security warning because this plugin is not signed.

To bypass Gatekeeper:
1. Open your DAW (Logic Pro, Ableton, etc.)
2. When you first load Transitionist, macOS will block it
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security
4. Scroll down and click "Open Anyway" next to Transitionist warning
5. Confirm you want to open it

You only need to do this once per plugin format (VST3 and AU).

PLUGIN INFO:
- Version: 1.0.0
- Formats: VST3, AU
- Parameters: Transition, Reverb, Delay, Delay Sync, Dry/Wet, Volume
- Description: a transition-focused audio effect combining tempo-synced
  delay, freeze-capable reverb, and a bipolar resonant filter into
  intuitive macro controls.

UNINSTALLATION:
To remove Transitionist:
1. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Transitionist.vst3
2. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Transitionist.component
3. Restart your DAW

COMPATIBILITY:
- macOS 14.6 or later recommended
- Built for your Mac architecture
